Given $△PQR$ shown above, which of the following diagrams represents the height corresponding to $\overset{―}{RQ}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The height (or altitude) corresponding to $\overset{―}{RQ}$ is a line segment that 

- runs from the opposite vertex $P$ to the line $\overset{⟷}{RQ},$ and

- is perpendicular to $\overset{⟷}{RQ}.$

The correct diagram is shown below.
